docs.title: Overview
docs.text: AVPKit is a cross-platform SDK for audio and video processing. This guide will help you set up and start using AVPKit for your development projects.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before you begin, ensure you have the following:

  • An integrated development environment (IDE) suitable for your platform:
    • Android Studio: For Android development with Java or Kotlin.
    • IntelliJ IDEA: For cross-platform development with Java or Kotlin.
    • Xcode: For iOS development with Kotlin.
  • A Java Development Kit (JDK) installed on your system (except for iOS). You can download it from OpenJDK.
  • Basic knowledge of programming in Java or Kotlin.
  • An internet connection to download necessary files and dependencies.

docs.title: Step 1: Set Up Your Development Environment
For Android:
docs.text:
1. Open Android Studio.
  2. Create a new project or open an existing one.

  3. In your build.gradle file, add the following dependencies:

    implementation 'com.avpkit:avpkit-core:1.0.0'

docs.title: For Windows, macOS, and Linux:
docs.text:
1. Use a suitable IDE (IntelliJ IDEA for cross-platform development).
  2. Ensure you have the necessary build tools and compilers installed for your platform, including a JDK.
  3. Add the AVPKit library dependency from Maven Central to your build configuration.
GradleMaven 
implementation 'com.avpkit:avpkit-core:1.0.0'

<dependency>
    <groupId>com.avpkit</groupId>
    <artifactId>avpkit-core</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0</version>
</dependency>

docs.title: Step 2: Explore the Documentation
docs.text:
1. Visit the AVPKit documentation to explore detailed guides, code samples, and API references.
  2. Check out the tutorials to learn how to implement various audio and video processing features.
